en.headline: Centre for Health Protection records four imported dengue and one chikungunya case
en.dek: The four dengue patients had travelled to Vietnam, Malaysia and Singapore; the chikungunya case involved a 44-year-old woman who had been on the mainland. Year-to-date dengue total reaches 40.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Friday that it recorded four imported dengue fever cases and one imported chikungunya fever case in the past week.

Of the dengue cases, three patients had visited Vietnam and one had visited Malaysia and Singapore during the incubation period. The city has recorded 40 dengue cases so far this year, comprising 38 imported and two local infections.

The chikungunya case involved a 44-year-old woman who had travelled to the mainland during the incubation period. The centre classified it as imported. She was treated in a mosquito-free hospital environment and has been discharged after recovery. The case was reported to mainland health authorities.

The centre noted that although Hong Kong has entered autumn, temperatures have not yet cooled significantly and occasional rain continues, conditions favourable for mosquito breeding. It reminded the public to take anti-mosquito measures both locally and when travelling to affected areas.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心錄得四宗外地傳入登革熱及一宗內地傳入基孔肯雅熱個案
zh.dek: 四宗登革熱患者潛伏期內曾到越南、馬來西亞及新加坡；基孔肯雅熱個案涉及一名44歲曾到內地的女子。今年累計登革熱40宗。
body: 衞生防護中心周五公布，過去一個星期錄得四宗外地傳入的登革熱感染個案，以及一宗內地傳入的基孔肯雅熱感染個案。
登革熱方面，三名病人潛伏期內曾到越南，一名曾到馬來西亞及新加坡。本港今年暫時累計錄得40宗登革熱個案，包括38宗外地傳入及兩宗本地感染。
基孔肯雅熱個案涉及一名44歲女子，潛伏期內曾到內地。中心認為屬輸入個案。病人在無蚊環境下接受治療後已康復出院，個案已通報內地衞生當局。
中心表示，香港雖已踏入秋季，但天氣尚未明顯轉冷且間中有雨，有利蚊子滋生。提醒市民無論在港或前往受蚊傳疾病影響地區，均應採取防蚊措施，避免被蚊叮咬。
